description: This file is a zsh completion script for git, providing command-line auto-completion features for git commands and options to the zsh shell.

methods.name: __gitcomp
methods.description: Handles completion for options with different patterns, such as '--no-...' or '--*='.

methods.name: __gitcomp_direct
methods.description: Provides completion for direct list of items.

methods.name: __git_complete_command
methods.description: Dispatches to the specific completion function for a given command.

methods.name: __git_zsh_bash_func
methods.description: Handles alias expansion and command completion via bash functions.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_common
methods.description: Provides descriptions for common git commands.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_alias
methods.description: Provides completion for git command aliases.

methods.name: __git_zsh_cmd_all
methods.description: Provides a list of all git commands.

methods.name: __git_zsh_main
methods.description: Main completion handler for zsh, managing command and argument completion states.
